primary_anchor_zh: 拱窗下的长沙发、面向书架的书桌和沙发旁的落地灯所构成的整体布局
story_reason_zh: 阅读室推拉门为隔开外侧回廊而缓慢关闭，随后重新打开

shot_design.role_zh: 建立主体与主要视觉锚点
shot_design.outline_zh: 整间阅读室在柔和日光中的拱窗阅读室，保持安静稳定，仅窗帘轻微摆动。
shot_design.main_action_zh: 保持安静稳定，仅窗帘轻微摆动
shot_design.anchor_visibility_zh: 拱窗下的长沙发、面向书架的书桌和沙发旁的落地灯所构成的整体布局占据足够画面面积并清楚可见。

shot_design.outline_zh: 宽大的木质推拉门缓慢关闭并遮住阅读室，画面只留下窄石回廊
shot_design.main_action_zh: 宽大的木质推拉门缓慢关闭并遮住阅读室，画面只留下窄石回廊
shot_design.connection_to_story_zh: 门、屏风或入口帘的开合符合场景用途，动作缓慢，镜头保持固定。
shot_design.remaining_visual_zh: 阅读室外侧的窄石回廊

shot_design.role_zh: 重新呈现主体并触发长期召回
shot_design.outline_zh: 木质推拉门缓慢打开，重新露出完整阅读室布局
shot_design.main_action_zh: 木质推拉门缓慢打开，重新露出完整阅读室布局
shot_design.visual_correspondence_zh: Shot 3 重新展示拱窗下的长沙发、面向书架的书桌和沙发旁的落地灯所构成的整体布局，以整体空间关系作为唯一验收目标。

generation_prompts.caption: A fixed wide shot frames a long sofa beneath an arched window, a writing desk facing the bookshelves, and a floor lamp beside the sofa inside a softly daylit reading room. A thin window curtain moves gently.

A fixed wide shot looks through an open entrance onto a long sofa beneath an arched window, a writing desk facing the bookshelves, and a floor lamp beside the sofa inside a softly daylit reading room. A broad wooden sliding door slowly closes across the entrance until the room is fully hidden, leaving only the narrow stone arcade in view.

A fixed wide shot holds on the narrow stone arcade. A broad wooden sliding door slowly opens, revealing a long sofa beneath an arched window, a writing desk facing the bookshelves, and a floor lamp beside the sofa inside a softly daylit reading room.

transition_design.shot_2_exit_action_zh: 宽大的木质推拉门缓慢关闭并遮住阅读室，画面只留下窄石回廊
transition_design.shot_2_remaining_visual_zh: 阅读室外侧的窄石回廊
transition_design.shot_3_return_action_zh: 木质推拉门缓慢打开，重新露出完整阅读室布局
transition_design.design_note_zh: Scene/layout 无法自行离场，因此 Shot 2 用自然遮挡结构缓慢关闭，Shot 3 用对应开启动作重新露出整体布局。

duration_design.rationale_zh: Shot 1 保持 24 blocks 建立主体与视觉锚点；Shot 2 调整为 12 blocks，使主体缺席区间介于 V2 的 16 blocks 与 V3 的 8 blocks 之间；Shot 3 调整为 12 blocks，在总长 48 blocks 下形成中等记忆间隔难度。
